about: G-PAY-EXT-1: public and extended cards of two nodes, signed by the conformance agent identity (ANetCore identity.SuiteAgentController; Ed25519 seed SHA-256("anet-suite-identity-v1/cur")). card is the signed card byte for byte, payload its JWS payload. The public card names the hub's JWKS (jku); an extended card names none. A variant in not_configured is the public card: there is no extended card to give.
